text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Sorry again… I swore things would turn out differently this time, but…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap is visibly upset. This losing streak must be taking its toll.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Can you tell me what I need to do to win? What is it that I'm lacking?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: With the way things are now, I can barely down three bowls of rice… I'm just not myself.
choice_data_list: Slow and steady… Let's not rush it.
Let's get back into the swing of things!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: You're right. Maybe that losing streak just has me rattled.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: "The key to making a good product is to keep trying until you get it right."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: …That's what Tome always used to say. I wanna keep trying different approaches, just like everyone back home did.
choice_data_list: Let's give it all we've got!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With Oguri Cap back to her usual self, I have high hopes for her next race.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: …Get back into the swing of things, huh?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: You're right. Back home, even if we had a bad harvest, it would never faze anyone.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: They'd just laugh and say, "Keep on keepin' on."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I can't let this faze me—just like how a little bit of misfortune never fazed them.
choice_data_list: Let's keep on keepin' on, Oguri!
Let's keep on keepin' on, Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her eyes sparkling, Oguri Cap and I take our training to the next level.
